comment: Entries the runs of results/logins-2026-11-17 would add to observed/manifest.json (T-74, branch campaign/logins). limits: the 13 rows replace existing rows; the claude-fable-5-2 row is new. runs: appended to runs. limits: each REPLACES the existing row of the same route, client and model (one row each). excluded: appended to excluded. Nothing here is a result: build_observed.py computes them from the raw files.

runs.note: plain probe through CLIProxyAPI pinned to the Codex login (temporary alias probe/gpt-6.1-sol). Hit 2 of 3 at 2.5 minutes and 3 of 3 at 5 minutes, then misses at some later ages (0 of 3 at 1 h, 2 of 3 at 2 h). The published 0 means that there is no tested age through which every check hit, not that this route does not cache. Of the earlier runs of this model on this route, C1 (cpa-8.0.53, 2026-11-04, plain probe with a cache key) also checked from 2.5 minutes and missed at 5 and 7.5 minutes (2 and 1 of 3), X1 started at 5 minutes, and H1, H2 were made by other clients (coding tools, low reasoning, larger prompts), so this is not a comparison that shows a change. Three window requests of 921,500 tokens went to the same login one to two minutes before the priming, and the owner's own sessions use the login. Early misses also occurred without a large request before the priming and without two models priming at once: GS1 and GA1 (logins-gpt-6-2-2026-11-17, GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, the same evening) each missed 1 of 3 at 2.5 minutes. That does not rule out every kind of load, and it says nothing certain about the cause of this run's misses, which is not established. The missing session_id is not the cause: CLIProxyAPI copies prompt_cache_key into the upstream session id. CL1 (logins-long-2026-11-17), primed about four hours later with no window request before it, continues this run and is published with it: it missed again, and its data end at 2 h (the proxy refused its 4-, 8- and 12-hour checks, and a restart of the Mac cut it off before 24 h). Served by build ngvoicu-local-e8d8d777 (process of 2026-11-16 18:48:58); its 2-hour checks ran at 14:27 UTC through build ngvoicu-local-a64b6855 (the owner restarted the proxy at 16:18:13 local), every earlier request through e8d8d777. The Codex login answered those checks: from the restart to 16:29:29 its request counter rose by exactly the 6 two-hour checks of LC1 and LC3 and the OpenAI API key by none, and the alias probe/... exists on that login only
